source: A game where everyone is an Animal and they can turn to any Animal they want. And it's gonna be a roleplay game so there should be a lot of clothes, accessories, and other to wear in button that has a text called "closet" to customize (the button is located at the top right corner), you can also changer your fur color, eye color, basically you can change every part of your body to what color you like! Even the clothes! You can change your ear type, mouth, tail if you want it fluffy or whatever you want, and basically everything too! There should also be a button under the "closet" button called "Animals", so you can choose any animal in the world! Even rare breeds for the Animals like a Khao Manee for cats and Ayam Cemani for Chickens! To pick your breed, the player should click the Animal they want to be and then they can pick the breed they wanted! The game should be VERY VERY DETAILED. No bugs, no lags, and there should be a button called "Settings" if the person want music in the background, sound effects, brightness of the game, invite friends, donate robux to the game, and even if they want to play low quality, normal quality and high quality! For new player, they will start with a cat (they can change it if they want to at the "Animals" button), and with normal quality.\n\nFor the map, it should be beautiful and very detailed, there should be a button called "Teleport" under the "Settings" Button so the player can teleport to the City, Forest, Jungle, Desert, Beach, Plains, Farm, Mountain, Snow place, And Rain forest!

answers.ask: Realistic nature, or a soft stylised look for the biomes?
answers.answer: Use a soft stylised look for the biomes, while keeping them beautiful and very detailed for roleplay.

answers.ask: Should the ten biomes be one connected world you can walk between, or separate places only reachable by teleport?
answers.answer: Make them separate places reached through the Teleport button, so each detailed biome can load smoothly without lag.

scene_prompt: Create a beautiful, highly detailed animal roleplay world in a soft stylised visual style, with ten separate teleport-accessed biome maps: City, Forest, Jungle, Desert, Beach, Plains, Farm, Mountain, Snow place, and Rain forest. Each biome is a self-contained, immersive environment designed for animal-scale exploration and roleplay, with distinct terrain, vegetation, natural landmarks, and appropriate built structures where relevant; the City includes streets and buildings, while the Farm includes cultivated fields and farm structures. Keep the biomes separate rather than physically connected.
